title: File:Victoria Spartz at the bill signing of the Ukraine Democracy Defense Lend-Lease Act of 2022.jpg
desc:
I was honored to attend the signing of the bipartisan Lend-Lease Act today. 
This landmark legislation will help the people of Ukraine stop Putin’s barbaric invasion and bring peace back to Europe. 

Learn more here: https://spartz.house.gov/media/press-releases/spartz-attends-ukraine-defense-lend-l
